schema_documentation:
12 top-level keys, present in 100% of the 1,168 records.

| key | type | presence | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `consultation_id` | int | 100% | unique |
| `post_id` | str | 100% | WordPress post id |
| `url` | str | 100% | `https://www.opengov.gr/{code}/?p={id}` |
| `title` | str | 100% | consultation title; 700 distinct. 218/1,168 are exactly «Ολοκλήρωση Δημοσίευσης Διαβούλευσης» (222 as substring); other frequent placeholders: «Ολοκλήρωση Δημόσιας Διαβούλευσης» 71, «Έκθεση Δημόσιας Διαβούλευσης» 43, «Ολοκλήρωση της Δημόσιας Διαβούλευσης» 32, «Ολοκλήρωση Διαβούλευσης» 30 |
| `start_minister_message` | str | 100% (1,167 non-empty) | opening ministerial statement |
| `end_minister_message` | str | 100% (641 non-empty) | closing statement, mostly trivial |
| `start_date` / `end_date` | str | 100% | ISO datetime `2026-03-31T22:25:00` |
| `scraped_at` | str \| null | 100% (null in ~2%) | ISO datetime |
| `ministry` | **dict** | 100% | `{ministry_id:int, code:str, name:str, url:str}`; 36 ministries (36 distinct ids / codes / names) |
| `articles` | **list[dict]** | 100% | 30,505 total, mean 26.1 per consultation, max 279 (5 consultations exceed 183) |
| `documents` | **list[dict]** | 100% | `{document_id, title, url, type}` — links only, NO text |

`articles[]` sub-keys: `article_id` int, `title` str, `url` str, `body_text` str, `comments` list[dict].
`comments[]` sub-keys: `comment_row_id` int, `content` str, **`date` str** (the README omits `date`).
semantic_meaning: opengov.gr public consultations: draft-law articles with citizen comments, plus ministerial opening and closing statements.
split_group_rule: Hash originating source identity; dictionary group by normalized lemma; recipes by normalized recipe title conservatively across ingredient variants; sentiment by complete normalized review content. Global duplicate components must share a split.
